messages:
maria: Starting follow-up for the postmortem on last night's token-validation 401 blips and missing audit rows. Short windows (~4-6m) where valid tokens were rejected; audit pipeline shows gaps. Need owners, quick mitigations, and a detection rule.

kunal: I'll take client-side mitigation: add jittered backoff (2 retries, cap 800ms) behind a feature flag and coordinate a 24h canary. Opening INF-27111. ETA Mon EOD.

priya: I'll own audit durability. Hypothesis: audit-writer OOMs when memcache churns and drops events. Plan: add local write-ahead buffer + fs spillover and metric dropped_audit_events_total. Filing SRE-11677. ETA 7 days.

ben: Infra will tune token cache and autoscale. Quick plan: increase hot-token TTL to 4m and add scale-up trigger on sustained miss_rate > 60% for 5m. I'll run staging load tests. PR inbound.

maria: TL;DR actions: kunal INF-27111 (client retry) due 2026-04-01; priya SRE-11677 (audit buffer) due 2026-04-06; ben infra PR (cache + autoscale) due 2026-04-03. Post updates here.

priya: Detection rule draft (PromQL) to add to our alerting pool:
```
expr: rate(token_audit_written_total{env="prod"}[15m]) < (0.3 * avg_over_time(rate(token_audit_written_total{env="prod"}[1d])[1d:1d]))
for: 10m
```
Will convert to our DSL and tune.

kunal: Dep: SDK release window + 24h canary. Est: 5 dev hrs + 3 QA hrs.

ben: Repro note: used `wrk -t4 -c120` on staging to recreate miss spikes. Logs attached to PR.

audit-bot: scheduled recurring follow-up "token-validation-remediation" weekly Wed 10:00 UTC for 3 weeks. Invites sent to maria, kunal, priya, ben.

maria: Thanks. Please post PR/JIRA links and one-line status updates here. We'll close when all PRs merged, JIRAs triaged, and the new alert is quiet for 48h. :white_check_mark:
